title: Substation Protection Event Tape Recovery

unresolved_gates: Capability-matched CPU DSP/sequence baseline failed: active score 0.17741133494247327 versus nearest-training-record active score 0.42941531060045035.
Metric-null audit failed: one-head/no-entity oracles retained active scores from 0.482453488073577 to 0.5470400296515936.
Full packaging is paused permanently for this pilot unless a future approved formulation restarts readiness from scratch.

dataset: A Dataset of Real-World Oscillograms from Electric Power Grids (OscGrid), Figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28465427
license: CC BY 4.0 on the official Figshare dataset record

evidence.native_targets: COMTRADE digital ML event intervals plus breaker commands, breaker positions, FABT/RNM operations, and transition timing
evidence.duplicate_scan: Refreshed 2026-08-10. Content scan over local Shipd archives, domain docs, and registry for OscGrid/protection-event/COMTRADE/breaker/oscillogram terms found 0 files outside this pilot; filename scan over Sprint 3/Sprint 4 output and accepted roots found 0 matching files outside this pilot.
evidence.redesign_attempt: Split changed from calibration family to physical channel family, and the draft metric increased entity weight/caps to test whether null and nearest-record shortcuts were still material.
evidence.capability_matched_baseline_method: ExtraTrees count model plus peak-based per-bin event/entity/transition classifiers on channel-invariant DSP features.
evidence.retrieval_attack_components: Sliding-window channel-invariant normalized cross-correlation, SimHash-style fingerprinting, and banded DTW reranking under crop, resampling, bus/phase permutation, normalization, quantization, and noise.
evidence.rejection_reason: After one honest redesign, split stability and public-source retrieval passed but capability-matched baseline and metric-null gates remained failed; proceeding would require non-defensible grader compensation.

proposed_input: Anonymized, normalized multi-channel voltage/current oscillogram plus analog channel dictionary; all digital and ML label channels removed.
proposed_output: Ordered discrete event tape with event kind, anonymous bus/equipment, start/end time bin, breaker command/state transitions, and confidence.
status_note: Rejected/archive-ready on 2026-08-10 after bounded readiness pilot and one redesign attempt. Native targets, official access, license, source package, scale, split stability, duplicate scan, import route, and robust public-source retrieval passed. The task failed the capability-matched CPU baseline gate and metric-null gate: nearest-training-record active score 0.4294 exceeded the intended DSP/sequence active score 0.1774, and one-head/no-entity oracle outputs retained high active score. Full packaging must not resume from this pilot.
